Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single isolated transparent PNG concept sprite for Question Hall, the hero building of a cozy mathematics academy village game. This is CONCEPT REVIEW, not final game-ready art.
Create ONE building only, fully visible, transparent background, generous clear margin. Wide horizontal academic hall with a grand central gable and a modest blue domed cupola, two lower symmetrical wings, cream/beige stonework, deep royal-blue/navy tiled roofs, restrained muted gold trim, a small open-book relief over the entrance, glowing warm amber symmetrical arched windows, and one very clear south-facing central DOUBLE WOODEN DOOR. No steps extending far forward, no grass ground island, no trees, no people, no labels, no lettering, no UI, no watermark. Any tiny entrance planting must remain attached to the building footprint.
Style: deliberate crisp low-resolution pixel art, cozy 16/32-bit RPG village architecture, 3/4 top-down front view, orthographic with no perspective convergence; the south-facing facade horizontal and the roof visible from above, no diagonal isometric orientation. Visible square pixel clusters of consistent size, clean dark warm outlines, limited harmonized colors, upper-left daylight, shadows down/right, no smooth painterly brush strokes or anti-aliased edges. Pixel art material scale should harmonize with a 32x32 grass-and-paving tileset: leafy grass #7eaa58, warm pathway #d6c7a9, light beige-gray plaza #dcd7c9. Building walls warm #e2caa0, roof mid #365f92 with navy shadows #243952, gold accents #c5a15c. Strong readable silhouette and academic identity at game camera zoom.
Composition: artwork deliberately wide, about 1.65:1 width-to-height, with the ground-facing wall mass broad enough to represent a 704x384 world-pixel collision footprint. Later target sprite canvas is 768x512; do not print these numbers. This is the visual master for a terracotta admin cottage and a plum dormitory to be created subsequently. Favor an inviting, polished hero-building concept and clear architectural hierarchy.
profileCenter: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated pixel-art building concept for Cozy Academy Village. Beige plaster, honey wood, amber window glass, harmonious with 32px grass tiles #7eaa58, warm stone #d6c7a9 and pale plaza #dcd7c9. A humble MEDIUM COTTAGE, not a palace, not a church, not an academic hall. Absolutely NO classical columns, NO portico, NO gold cornice, NO gold finials, NO dome, NO tower, NO long arcade or repeated arched colonnade. Transparent background, no backdrop, no gradient halo, no bloom or surrounding glow; light is represented by flat amber window pixels only. A SINGLE wooden door just slightly right of facade centre (about 53% across the building width), a small square hanging pictogram plaque depicting a person/profile bust beside it, one warm window on either side, two small potted shrubs at the doorway. A tidy administration cottage. No grand ornamental entrance, no huge stone arch, no ornate gold decorations. Keep the ground footprint broad and rectangular so it can cover the current 608x352 collision footprint without changing the map. A few low stone base blocks, softly stepped roof silhouette, cozy daylight.
